answer: What survives to the pigment is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The juniper holds work receipts rather than names, so the ivory of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
